commit.message:
fix(tui): cancel a held burst Enter before Ctrl+T and Ctrl+G (#2407 item 2)

App-level shortcuts are handled above ChatWidget, so they skipped the
held-Enter cancellation that ChatWidget applies to every other Ctrl/Alt key.
Inside the 32 ms lookahead after an ambiguous Enter:

- Ctrl+T opened the transcript with the submission still armed, so the
  draft was submitted once the next redraw tick ran.
- Ctrl+G seeded the external editor without the unmaterialized burst text.

Both handlers now call ChatWidget::cancel_pending_burst_submission first,
which drops the held Enter and materializes the burst into the draft, exactly
as a Ctrl/Alt key routed to ChatWidget does. Ctrl+G cancels whether or not the
editor can launch, since the key is consumed either way.

Tests arm a held Enter on a controlled clock and drive the real keys through
App::handle_key_event; test-only helpers are #[cfg(test)].
